description: Small behavioral expectations transcribed from the Java node classes. These are compatibility-oracle records, not claims about current Lua support.

nodes.expect: Apply the selected numeric or model adjustment, including crew/item/title variants.
Multiply or set carried or cached money and then continue.
Represent armour as an item whose selected bonus contributes to Defence.
Block when forced; on selection validate price/capacity and create the authored item, ship, cargo, or crew change.
Enable only when flags, payment, life state, and destination are usable; navigate on selection.
Create or lift the typed, possibly cumulative affliction and activate or remove its effects.
Block when forced; roll two dice plus the chosen ability and adjustments, store the result, and dispatch success or failure.
Create or lift a disease with active reversible effects and immunity checks.
Attach ordered aura, wielded, tool, or use effects rather than execute children as section mutations.
Execute only when no preceding branch in the adjacent conditional chain matched.
Evaluate only when no preceding branch in the adjacent conditional chain matched.
Exclude matching item groups or attributes from the enclosing item operation.
Block while visibly acquiring a new keyed choice; persist it and activate it only at its configured address or section tag.
Execute only for a failed associated check and preserve nested continuation.
Bind an editable document field to the named adventurer property.
Block and preserve round, opponent, damage-hook, flee, and undo state until combat ends.
Run the paired fight hook after damage and replace normal damage when configured.
Run the paired hook before combat or after each completed round as configured.
Run the paired flee program at its authored combat timing.
Offer or immediately apply every authored gain atomically, then continue.
Block when forced; validate payment and life state, apply travel side effects, and navigate.
Treat child executables as one resumable forced or optional compound action.
Execute its child program only when all authored conditions and negation resolve true.
Resolve and expose the authored illustration without changing game state.
Restrict the enclosing item operation to matching item groups or attributes.
Create, remove, buy, sell, or test an item instance with quantity, tags, group, and effects.
Expose constrained deposit and withdrawal actions for the named persistent item cache.
Block when selection/payment is required; apply all authored losses atomically with fatality, blessings, and undo.
Enable a live repeatable transaction table and immediately continue outer section execution.
Expose deposit and withdrawal actions respecting maximum, multiples, and charges.
Execute the matching range branch and block on an owned forced destination when present.
Dispatch exactly one matching numeric or success/failure branch while preserving ordinary fallback choices.
Create or lift poison with active reversible effects and immunity checks.
Validate and apply the complete authored price as a resumable action.
Block when forced; roll the authored dice expression, store it, consume its flag, and retain undo state.
Block; roll authored dice and addend against Rank, then store and dispatch the signed result.
Undo effects attributable to the preceding Roller and invoke that same Roller again.
Block when required; validate cost and restore fixed or full Stamina using Java defaults.
Arrange, replace, or consume an eligible resurrection and navigate after death.
Block when forced and navigate to the previous eligible section.
Offer sequential or random section browsing without applying unrelated game mutations.
Validate ownership/cargo and apply the authored item, ship, cargo, or crew sale.
Set the authored variable or model property using expression, item, tag, cache, and dock modifiers.
Run only as the matching completed-transaction event.
Execute only for a successful associated check and preserve nested continuation.
Offer or immediately apply every authored tick atomically and record roll-linked undo.
Represent a tool whose selected effect modifies its named ability.
Expose repeatable ship, cargo, crew, and item transactions with live prices and capacity.
Block; roll for the selected ability, raise it when eligible, store variables, and retain undo state.
Block when selection is required and move only matching money/items between the authored endpoints.
Represent a weapon whose selection and effects contribute to combat.
Repeat and resume the child executable sequence while the authored variable condition remains true.

continuation_cases.name: forced-goto
continuation_cases.reload_expect: Before remains set, After remains unset, and the goto is still actionable.

continuation_cases.name: forced-check
continuation_cases.reload_expect: marker remains 1 and the same unresolved check is actionable.

continuation_cases.name: forced-random
continuation_cases.reload_expect: the authored random action is restored without repeating Before.

continuation_cases.name: rank-check
continuation_cases.reload_expect: the unresolved Rank roll and marker=1 are restored.

continuation_cases.name: training
continuation_cases.reload_expect: training remains actionable and no ability increase has happened early.

continuation_cases.name: fight-round
continuation_cases.reload_expect: enemy/player Stamina, round, active opponent, and marker=1 are restored.

continuation_cases.name: group-child
continuation_cases.reload_expect: the group resumes at the blocked child without replaying marker setup.

continuation_cases.name: market
continuation_cases.reload_expect: the live market is restored; leaving applies marker=2 exactly once.

continuation_cases.name: reroll
continuation_cases.reload_expect: the prior roll and its reversible mutation remain available to undo and repeat.

continuation_cases.name: return
continuation_cases.reload_expect: the same return destination is actionable without replaying marker setup.

continuation_cases.name: rest
continuation_cases.reload_expect: payment and healing have not occurred before the restored action is selected.

continuation_cases.name: resurrection
continuation_cases.reload_expect: the arrangement remains actionable and has not been acquired early.

continuation_cases.name: transfer
continuation_cases.reload_expect: source and target inventories remain unchanged until selection.

continuation_cases.name: selective-loss
continuation_cases.reload_expect: the selection is restored with no item removed twice.

continuation_cases.name: optional-tick
continuation_cases.reload_expect: the optional action remains available and its mutation is not duplicated.
